name: greedy_coloring
author: 4ebce3f0
description: Colours the nodes so that no two connected nodes share a colour, using a greedy algorithm, and reports how many colours it needed. Use it for scheduling and conflict questions: 'how many exam slots avoid all clashes?', 'split these nodes into groups with no links inside a group', 'what colour/slot does node X get?'. The number of colours is an upper bound on the chromatic number (the true minimum), not always the minimum. Works on undirected graphs, weighted or not (weights ignored); on directed graphs edge direction is ignored. Returns num_colors, the strategy used, and each colour class with its size and up to top_k member nodes; with 'node' it also returns that node's colour.

graph_id.description: Id of the graph to colour.

strategy.description: Order in which nodes are coloured: largest_first (highest degree first), dsatur (most differently coloured neighbours first; often uses fewer colours) or smallest_last.

top_k.description: How many member nodes to list for each colour class.

node.description: Optional exact node id (use lookup_node to find it); the result then also gives this node's colour.
